'''-Anniversary island has been removed, the starry balls are not tradeable-'''

Anniversary Starry Balls are mythic items obtained by opening Anniversary stars with a very low chance (chance has not been revealed yet), or completing the Anniversary Island stage (The Anniversary Island can be completed once every day). When you have collected all 7 Starry Balls, you can use them to summon Shenro in the lobby. You will keep the dragon balls until you wish for something.
[[File:Shenron.png|thumb|Shenro [AA Update 15 Anniversary Event]]]
